snippet.title: Punch-Out!! (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Nintendo, 1990 (Original Hardware, Composite)
snippet.description:
Punch-Out!! was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in  1990. All audio/visual elements copyright 1990, Nintendo. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/punch-out-mr-dream/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT PUNCH-OUT!! (NES)

When the contract licensing the use of Mike Tyson's name in the console version expired, Nintendo removed Mike Tyson from the game re-releasing it as Punch-Out!! Otherwise, this release is exactly the same as the original release "Mike Tyson's Punch Out!!".

AKA: Punch-Out!!, パンチアウト!!
